t: 第四次十字军东征袭击君士坦丁堡。拜占庭皇帝阿莱克修斯三世·安杰洛斯逃离首都流亡。
te: The Fourth Crusade assaults Constantinople. The Byzantine emperor Alexios III Angelos flees from his capital into exile.

dz: 阿莱克修斯四世·安杰洛斯 (Alexios IV Angelos) 在第四次十字军东征领导人的压力下，其父亲伊萨克二世·安杰洛斯 (Isaac II Angelos) 被加冕为拜占庭共治皇帝。
de: Alexios IV Angelos is crowned Byzantine co-emperor after his father Isaac II Angelos is pressured to do so by the leaders of the Fourth Crusade.
